comparison.a: Candidate A provides a very thorough plan with an excellent, detailed decision log. However, its milestone plan groups the delivery of all core feature plugins into a single, large phase, which is less iterative.
comparison.b: Candidate B proposes a superior milestone plan that breaks down feature delivery into smaller, sequential phases (B1-B5), better aligning with the iterative nature of a plugin architecture. This granular approach provides a clearer and more manageable path to delivery.

evidence.note: Candidate A groups the delivery of all core feature plugins into a single large milestone, which is less granular than B's approach.

payload.notes: Candidate B is the winner due to its significantly clearer and more practical milestone plan. By breaking feature delivery into small, sequential plugin-focused milestones, it better leverages the chosen plugin architecture and de-risks the project through genuine iterative progress.
